abstract: Placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) levels in sera and tissues from 40 patients with testicular tumor were measured using a monoclonal immuno-catalytic assay. The mean value of the PLAP levels of seminoma tissues was found to be 92-fold higher than that of normal testes, being significantly high compared with that of non-seminoma tissues. The mean value of the serum PLAP levels from patient's with seminoma was also significantly higher than that from patients with non-seminoma. In 2 groups of seminoma and mixed type tumor containing seminoma and non-seminoma components, the PLAP levels of tissues from patients who had high levels of the serum PLAP (greater than or equal to 100 mKAU) were significantly higher than those from patients who had normal serum PLAP levels (less than 100 mKAU). In the seminoma or mixed type tumor groups, the serum PLAP levels of all patients who had high levels before treatment decreased to within a normal range after orchiectomy with or without chemotherapy or radiation therapy. We conclude that PLAP seems to be an useful tumor marker for the diagnosis and the monitoring of response to treatment in patients with seminoma.
abstract_ja: 精巣腫瘍患者40例の血清および組織中の胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ（PLAP）レベルを、モノクローナル免疫触媒測定法を用いて測定した。セミノーマ組織のPLAPの平均値は正常精巣の92倍と高く、非セミノーマ組織と比較して有意に高値であった。セミノーマの血清PLAP平均値も非セミノーマより有意に高かった。セミノーマおよびセミノーマ成分と非セミノーマ成分を含む混合型腫瘍の2群では、血清PLAPが高値（100 mKAU以上）の患者の組織PLAPは、正常範囲（100 mKAU未満）の患者より有意に高かった。セミノーマまたは混合型腫瘍群において、治療前に血清PLAPが高値であった全患者は、精巣摘除術後（化学療法または放射線療法の有無を問わず）に正常範囲まで低下した。以上より、PLAPはセミノーマの診断および治療反応のモニタリングに有用な腫瘍マーカーであると結論する。
